name: Slice the pie
description: Check the room from outside before entering.

name: Stack order
description: Operators enter in their assigned order.

name: Announce entry
description: Call out when moving through a door.

name: Ammo check
description: Do not enter with a nearly empty weapon.

name: Speed
description: Enter within 4 seconds of the go signal.

name: Leave the fatal funnel
description: Do not stall in the doorway.

name: Sector discipline
description: Cover only your sector until it is clear.

name: No flagging
description: Never point your weapon at a teammate.

name: Threat priority
description: Engage armed threats before unarmed ones.

name: Rear security
description: The last operator watches behind the team.

name: Call your reload
description: Announce a reload so the team can cover you.
